notes: All 36 rows verified against sources opened directly: K.S.A. 45-219, 45-218, 45-254 fetched from ksrevisor.gov (site current through the 2026 session; LCC docs dated 08/17/2026 on page) and Executive Order 18-05 fetched as the filed PDF from the KGI online library. Every source_language segment matched the opened text verbatim after normalizing two rendering artifacts: the Revisor pages put a space before the period following a hyperlinked cite ('K.S.A. 45-219 .'), and the EO PDF text layer renders '(100)' as '(1 00)'. Currency: 45-219 history ends 'L. 2025, ch. 89, sec. 1; July 1' (the HB 2134 amendment the rows claim — review/redaction costs, lowest-cost-staff/salary-basis/no-benefits, and subsection (e) are all present in the opened text); 45-218 history ends L. 1984; 45-254 ends L. 2021, ch. 82 — so no 2024-2026 amendment is missing from any row. Municipal scope: K.S.A. 45-217(k) opened — 'public agency' includes any political or taxing subdivision, so all_public_bodies rows bind municipalities; agency-only figures (EO 18-05, DoA/SOS schedules, (c)(5)-(7), (d)) are consistently kept out of municipal values. Two rows carry disclosed derivations rather than stated figures and were confirmed on that disclosed basis: rules.deposit.percent (100% ceiling read from 'advance payment of the prescribed fee', manual_verification flag present, confidence medium) and rules.deposit.threshold (value 'none' mapped to engine threshold=0). The AG's KORA FAQ/Citizen's Guide remained unopened here as in discovery (the raw file's gaps_manual_verification list already routes that to a human); no row depends on it as its source. Verification did not need to open the Kansas Supreme Court judicial-branch fee rules (outside municipal scope, and the one delegation row marked opened:false is not a resolution row).
